app.name: Railway CLI
app.one_liner: A Rust-based command-line interface for interacting with Railway infrastructure, supporting agent integration, multiple installation methods, and non-interactive workflows.

screens.name: Main CLI Interface
screens.purpose: Provide entry point for all Railway CLI commands including project management, environment configuration, and agent setup.

rust_commands.name: edit_config_by_project
rust_commands.purpose: Modify environment configuration scoped to a specific Railway project.

rust_commands.name: login_browserless
rust_commands.purpose: Enable authentication in headless environments like SSH sessions without browser access.

rust_commands.name: setup_agent
rust_commands.purpose: Automatically configure detected AI coding agents (e.g., Cline, Roo Code) by detecting CLINE_ACTIVE or ROO_ACTIVE environment variables.

mvp_plan: week 1: Add support for token-based authentication
week 1: Implement core CLI scaffolding in Rust
week 1: Integrate agent detection via environment variables
acceptance_tests: Authentication succeeds in SSH session using browserless login
CLI installs successfully via install.sh and runs `railway setup agent` automatically
Cline and Roo Code are detected when their respective env vars are set
Command `railway edit config` works per project as introduced in v4.57.2
